analyst.summary: RHI Magnesita India makes heat-resistant refractory materials for steel, cement and glass furnace linings. The company reported a large accounting loss this year, but that was almost entirely due to a one-time writedown of an investment in a subsidiary hurt by weak exports and currency moves -- the actual India manufacturing business kept growing revenue and stayed profitable at the operating level, and the board still recommended a healthy dividend. We rate it a Hold: the headline loss looks worse than the underlying business, which remains steady, but the subsidiary weakness behind the writedown is worth watching.
